wireframe-align: New in 8c: the whole Sign in button selected on its screen. Its bar shows Align ▾ in place of six inline align buttons, so it is narrower, with Align ▾ open above it holding the six buttons. The base bar, at the same height, shows the six inline buttons and nothing open.
wireframe-phone-pieces: Changed in 8c: at 600 px the strip under the open picker shows iPhone ▾ after Pieces, which moves Add a label, Fill, Stroke and Corners right.
wireframe-screen: Changed in 8c: the selected screen's bar shows iPhone ▾ after Pieces, which moves the bar's other buttons right.
wireframe-size: New in 8c: the Sign in button's box selected. Its bar gains Align ▾ and 345 × 48 ▾ after Pieces, which moves the other buttons right, with the size dropdown open above it: X, Y, W and H two to a row, and Rotate° across. The base bar, at the same height, has neither and nothing open.
